title: Advances on two spectral conjectures regarding booksize of graphs
summary: The booksize $ \mathrm{bk}(G) $ of a graph $ G $, introduced by Erdős, refers to the maximum integer $ r $ for which $G$ contains the book $ B_r $ as a subgraph. This paper investigates two open problems in spectral graph theory related to the booksize of graphs. First, we prove that for any positive integer $r$ and any $ B_{r+1} $-free graph $ G $ with $ m \geq (9r)^2 $ edges, the spectral radius satisfies $ ρ(G) \leq \sqrt{m} $.
